name: Freelance / self-employment residence permit (§ 21 AufenthG)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires practicing a recognised liberal profession (Freier Beruf) — e.g. consultant, artist, writer, IT freelancer, translator, or a licensed profession (doctor, lawyer, architect).
This requires the relevant professional qualification or licence where the profession is regulated.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain the required licence or qualification recognition.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires evidence of demand for your services — client letters of intent, existing contracts, or a credible client pipeline.
requirements.fix_path: Secure client letters of intent or signed contracts before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a viable business plan showing economic interest or regional need, positive economic impact, and secured financing — assessed by the local chamber of commerce or trade and the immigration authority.
requirements.fix_path: Develop a business plan meeting the economic-interest and financing-secured criteria, and obtain a supporting assessment from the relevant chamber.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires proof of secured financing for the business (own capital, loan commitment, or investor funding).
If over 45, this requires adequate provision for old age (private pension or equivalent) unless exempt.

evidence_required.document: Client letters of intent or contracts (Freiberufler route)

notes: Genuinely two distinct qualifying paths under one statutory route (§21), similar in shape to UK Innovator Founder's endorsement-vs-prize split, or UK ILR's multi-group structure — Freiberufler (liberal professions, lighter bar) vs Gewerbetreibende (commercial self-employed, must show economic interest/regional need). Settlement after 3 years (36 months) is CONDITIONAL on the business being successful and livelihood secured (§21(4)) — otherwise falls back to the standard 5-year (60-month) settlement timeline generally. pr_after_months encodes the accelerated 3-year figure as the realistic target outcome, but this is a real conditional the flat number doesn't fully capture — same class of simplification flagged on several UK routes (uk_student, uk_graduate family_can_join conditionals). No fixed minimum investment figure exists in the statute (unlike UK Innovator Founder's now-removed £50k threshold) — financing adequacy is assessed case-by-case against the specific business plan, which is a genuine structural difference worth surfacing in any 'minimum investment' comparison view.
